name: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd
description: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd (IRCTC) is a Miniratna CPSE under the Ministry of Railways, holding a complete sovereign monopoly in online railway ticketing, packaged drinking water (Rail Neer), and onboard catering across the vast Indian Railways network. The enterprise also operates luxury tourist trains and integrated tourism travel packages.

company_profile.summary: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd (IRCTC) is a Miniratna CPSE under the Ministry of Railways, holding a complete sovereign monopoly in online railway ticketing, packaged drinking water (Rail Neer), and onboard catering across the vast Indian Railways network. The enterprise also operates luxury tourist trains and integrated tourism travel packages.

revenue_breakup.desc: Convenience fees from booking 1.5M+ train tickets daily on IRCTC website and mobile app.
Pantry car contracts, onboard food supply, executive railway lounges, and station food plazas.
Exclusive manufacturing and distribution of Rail Neer bottled water across railway platforms.
Bharat Gaurav religious tours, air ticketing, cruise packages, and semi-high-speed Tejas trains.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (India): 100% across the 68,000 km Indian Railways network
moats_and_strengths: Absolute regulatory monopoly as the sole authorized online ticket booking platform for Indian Railways.
Extremely sticky consumer base booking over 1.5 million rail tickets daily with negative working capital.
Extraordinary EBITDA margins in internet ticketing exceeding 80% with low maintenance capital expenditure.
Completely debt-free balance sheet generating strong return on equity (ROE > 40%) and high dividend payouts.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Daily Ticket Volume: 1.5M+ tickets • Rail Neer Capacity: 1.8M liters/day across 19 bottling plants

bullish_triggers: Induction of hundreds of Vande Bharat express trains driving onboard catering revenue per passenger.
Expanding Rail Neer bottling plant capacity to capture 100% of demand across all Indian railway stations.
Monetization of digital traffic via digital advertising, travel insurance, and hotel cross-selling.
bearish_risks: Policy decisions by Ministry of Railways regarding convenience fee sharing or ticket pricing mandates.
Food quality compliance incidents or catering vendor service standard penalties.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
